edges.subject: CLN6
edges.quote: Batten disease caused by defects in CLN6

edges.subject: CLN8
edges.quote: Lysosomal enzymes are synthesized in the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) and transferred to the Golgi complex by interaction with the Batten disease protein CLN8

edges.subject: CLN6
edges.quote: CLN6 as an obligate component of a CLN6-CLN8 complex (herein referred to as EGRESS: ER-to-Golgi relaying of enzymes of the lysosomal system), which recruits lysosomal enzymes at the ER to promote their Golgi transfer

edges.subject: CLN6
edges.object: impaired ER export of lysosomal enzymes
edges.quote: CLN6 deficiency results in inefficient ER export of lysosomal enzymes and diminished levels of the enzymes at the lysosome

edges.subject: CLN6
edges.quote: These results identify CLN6 and the EGRESS complex as key players in lysosome biogenesis
